column2: Game sprite for a turn-based strategy board game map, seen from above at a three-quarter angle like a piece of a miniature diorama, soft painterly cel shading, thin dark outlines, vivid natural colours, sunlight coming from the upper left, readable when shrunk to a small icon, centred, filling about 75 percent of the frame width. The subject stands directly on the background: no block of earth under it, no cliff, no cross-section, no ground platform, no cast shadow, no text, no letters. The background is a perfectly flat solid pure magenta colour #FF00FF everywhere around the subject, with no gradient and no texture. Subject: two silver fish leaping out of the sea with a small white splash of water between them.
